an4.240:1.1: catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an4.240:1.3: sabyāpajjhena kāyakammena, sabyāpajjhenavacīkammena, sabyāpajjhena manokammena, sabyāpajjhāya diṭṭhiyā.
an4.240:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an4.240:2.1: catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
an4.240:2.3: abyāpajjhena kāyakammena, abyāpajjhena vacīkammena, abyāpajjhena manokammena, abyāpajjhāya diṭṭhiyā.
an4.240:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ saggeti.
